featured_reviews.name: Neha Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a party at Sangam Hall (Marine Drive) for my son's 5th birthday and it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. From our initial meeting with Mr. Alok, he was always attentive and detail-oriented. He took the time to understand our preferences, making suggestions that enhanced our plans while remaining within our budget. On the day of the event, everything was executed flawlessly. The venue was beautifully decorated, exactly as we had discussed. The staff was friendly and efficient, ensuring that all our guests were well taken care of. The food was delicious. Event Host Hansa was just spectacular and so multi talented and managed everything so well. We could relax and enjoy the celebration knowing that everything was in capable hands.
Thanks Mr. Alok and the entire team at Sangam Hall. My son's birthday was a memorable and magical experience. I highly recommend their services for any event and I will certainly be returning for future celebrations! Keep up the good work.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Dere
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently hosted my baby's naming ceremony at Sangam Hall and couldn't be happier with the experience. The services were excellent, and the appetizers were the highlight – extremely tasty! The main course was equally delicious. The staff was very cordial, and the owner, Alok, went above and beyond to personally ensure everything was well-organized and that all our guests were looked after. I highly recommend Sangam Hall for any special occasion. Thank you, Alok, and the entire team for making our event unforgettable!

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Good service and food.was also delicious.

featured_reviews.name: Vijai Konishetty
featured_reviews.review_text: From the food to the service, our experience at Sangam hall was truly outstanding in every way, and we feel incredibly fortunate to have had such a wonderful experience. Mr. Alok played a huge role in making our baby shower function a fantastic success, with the food being absolutely amazing.

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Chaughule Vaidya
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted a birthday party at this banquet, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely delicious, with every dish perfectly prepared and presented, earning compliments from all the guests.

The event management was top-notch, with everything executed in a highly professional manner. The magic show added a wonderful touch of entertainment, keeping both kids and adults thoroughly engaged and amazed.

The decorations were stunning and beautifully aligned with the birthday theme, creating a festive and vibrant atmosphere that truly made the event memorable.

A big thank you to the owner Alok ji and his entire team for their hard work and dedication in making this celebration so special. Highly recommended for anyone looking to host a flawless and unforgettable event!

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi All,

I recently had the pleasure of booking Sangam hall for my wedding function (Mehendi & Sangeet) on 7th May 2024 and I can't praise it enough. The team was incredibly professional and accommodating, ensuring every detail was meticulously planned and executed. The staff were attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist with a smile, making the entire event run smoothly.

The food was outstanding, both in quality and quantity. Every dish was flavorful, beautifully presented, and there was more than enough to satisfy all our guests. We received numerous compliments on the meal, which made the day even more special.

A special mention goes to Mr. Aalok Agarwal and his entire team, whose exceptional service truly made our day unforgettable. professionalism and a genuine desire to make our day special.

Thanks

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Master
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mr. Alok was very co-operative regards to coordinating and communicating from the start till end of the function.
The decor was well organised with appropriate seating arrangements as mentioned by them. Food served was upto the mark. I would highly recommend this hall for small occasions like birthday party, naming ceremony, kids function.

featured_reviews.name: Saumitra Trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text: We have hosted almost 4 to 5 events at Sangam Hall in last 3 years. It has always been awesome experience. Kudos to Personal touch and hospitality of Mr Alok Agarwal.

featured_reviews.name: Hozefa Topiwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
MVM Banquets is a good place for hosting small functions and its location is truly superb. The hall is convenient and easy for guests to reach. The only challenge is that no parking is available, so visitors need to park on the road. One important point for anyone planning to book is to cross check all details in advance. Decoration and catering may have monopoly arrangements and the real cost can sometimes be hidden in these services rather than in the rent of the venue. Overall it is a nice place, just make sure to confirm everything before finalising your booking.

featured_reviews.name: Juzar Mustan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly recommend this venue for small events. They have banquet halls of different sizes and on different floors. Works well for mixed functions. Service is excellent. Their inhouse deco partner is very good. Valet parking service is available at a fee.

Overall, they are responsive and do their best to accommodate special requests.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: The caterer having very bad service some of their waiters are wearing caps and hand gloves no pro for service with staters and juice waiters don't no the name of juice and none of the manager are their in the hall to look for the services

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Farhan Ariwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
The catering staff and all others employed during the function are absolutely outstanding. So is the food and decorations.
However, the people incharge of the hall, that is the manager and decorator are nothing short but liars. They made a quotation to us with various promises, and when the time came for our event, everything was changed. They even changed the menu we decided, just so that it is easier on them. Worst of all, they acted like everything was our fault, and refused to take any accountability. Purely despicable. I hope the owners see this review.

featured_reviews.name: Shardul Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: We had our even on June 1, 2024 at MVM. We had a wonderful time. The food was delicious and all had a great time.

featured_reviews.name: Vimarsha Ramesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I attended one of my friends wedding here and my friend and their family faced following issues.
1) charged us for speakers even though it was never mentioned before.
2) the speaker and projector they gave didn't work properly, and the staff who was attending it couldn't help us. Didn't have a normal audio jack to connect our laptop to the speakers.
3) changed the menu from what we decided, and refusing to accept they did it on their own.
4) there were broken glass in the venue, which we saw like 2/3 weeks before, and they promised to get it fixed before our function. Which they didn't.
4) refusing to give our deposit back.
5) harassing us by continuously calling us, even though we told them, since you have cameras, share the video with us we'll have a look and see. If it's extra people, we will definitely pay. But they're just telling we need to pay.
6) the original quotation they gave us, and what we finally ended up actually paying, were vastly different.

featured_reviews.name: Saili Amberkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of booking MVM BANQUETS for my wedding, and I can't praise it enough. The team was incredibly professional and accommodating, ensuring every detail was meticulously planned and executed. The staff were attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist with a smile, making the entire event run smoothly.

The food was outstanding, both in quality and quantity. Every dish was flavorful, beautifully presented, and there was more than enough to satisfy all our guests. We received numerous compliments on the meal, which made the day even more special.

The interiors of the banquet hall are stunning, with elegant and tasteful decor that created the perfect ambiance for our celebration. The decor team did an exceptional job, transforming the space into a fairy tale setting that exceeded our expectations.

A special mention goes to Sandeep and Nishita, whose exceptional service truly made our day unforgettable. Sandeep was incredibly attentive to every detail, ensuring that everything ran smoothly and seamlessly. His professionalism and dedication were evident in every interaction. Nishita's creative touch and impeccable taste added a unique flair to our event, making the ambiance truly magical.

Also, Nitin and Mohit were incredibly attentive and responsive, addressing all of our concerns and requests with professionalism and a genuine desire to make our day special.

Overall, MVM provided an unforgettable wedding experience. A big thank you to Sandeep, Nishita, Mohit, and Nitin for their outstanding service and for making the day so special. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello All,

I recently had booked MVM BANQUETS for my wedding reception on 11th May 2024.

The entire staff / team were attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist with a smile, making the entire event run smoothly.

The food was outstanding, both in quality and quantity and every dish was beautifully presented to satisfy all our guests.

A special mention goes to Sandeep, Nishita, Nitin & Mohit whose exceptional service truly made our day unforgettable by serving the tasteful food and assisting all our guest wherever required.

A big thank you to Sandeep, Nishita, Mohit, and Nitin for their outstanding service and for making the day so special. Highly recommended!

The food was nothing short of excellent – every dish was thoughtfully prepared and bursting with flavor. The quality and presentation of the meals truly elevated the entire experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sahil Salian
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the finest hospitality arrangements I have ever seen. This review is for anyone or everyone who plan to have a wedding reception at this place for a crowd between 150 to 250

1. Ambience: Awesome, the hall was just setup to have a great reception with family and friends.
2. Decoration: Top notch. Starting from the idea, color combinations, the quantity, lightings, cut out designs all of them were to the T and accurate.
3. Food: The veg and the non-veg was top quality, it was served at the perfect temperature, the taste was the same that was approved. Almost every guest I spoke to had something unique to tell about a particular dish. Especially the cheese samosa and fish Koliwada was called out loud by my guests.
4. Organizers: Very hospitable, flexible, honest, transparent of what can be done, what can be improved, setup etc.
5. Staff: Very approachable and dignified for the crowd. Were well mannered and made sure every guest feels dignified.
6. Music: The Dj was shared a playlist apt for the occasion and he balanced the event excellently well having a mix of wedding and other musice for the dance.

I can keep going on and on, but anyone looking for a crowd of around 200 to celebrate an occasion in this town, it is 20downtown you want to be in.

Thank you for making our reception a memorable one.

featured_reviews.name: Surbhi Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful experience at 20 Downtown. The food was absolutely fantastic and truly enjoyed by all our guests. A special mention to the coordinators, Mr. Om Savanekar and Ms. Drashti Rathod, who were incredibly supportive and attentive till the very last moment. They ensured that all our requests were fulfilled seamlessly, making the entire event stress-free for us. The banquet was clean, well-maintained, and the staff and helpers were friendly and cooperative throughout. Overall, it was a memorable experience and we would highly recommend this venue.

featured_reviews.name: sanket gulavane
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hosted two separate events — a reception and a cocktail party — and the team at 20 Downtown, especially Om, understood the exact requirements for each event and delivered the best possible solutions.
The management team was extremely supportive and professional throughout, and the food was absolutely outstanding. All in all, they put up a fabulous show and made both events truly memorable!

featured_reviews.name: Anahita Nazir
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently booked 20 Downtown for our child’s first birthday, and it was a wonderful experience.

Event Manager: Ms. Khushboo, the proprietor, was extremely kind and accommodating. She customized the décor beautifully as per our request (without balloons) and even added a complimentary entrance decoration, which was a lovely gesture.

Staff: The staff were courteous, polite, and attentive throughout the event.

Event Experience: When our little one felt uncomfortable during the party, Ms. Khushboo personally comforted him with toys and soft music. That thoughtful gesture meant a lot to us.

Food: The food was excellent—every guest complimented both the taste and variety. The crispy bhindi was an absolute hit, and the starters were equally good.

Overall: A delightful experience at a decent and affordable price. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Afreen Talukdar
featured_reviews.review_text: 20 Downtown truly made our wedding a dream come true. From the moment we walked in, the ambience felt magical, and on the wedding day, they completely exceeded our expectations. The decor was absolutely stunning—every detail was thoughtfully done and perfectly matched our vision. The team was professional, supportive, and attentive throughout, making the entire experience smooth and stress-free. Our guests couldn’t stop complimenting the setup and overall vibe. Thank you, 20 Downtown, for hosting our special day and turning it into a beautiful, unforgettable memory. Highly recommended for anyone looking for perfection and elegance. ❤️✨

featured_reviews.name: krupa mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: 20 downtown was the perfect host for a small dinner party that i held there for my parents. Om was an amazing person whom we met and had the entire discussion with. He was very cooperative and gave valuable suggestions and gave us a very good price. The food was also very tasty and my entire family enjoyed it. He had men stationed at the gate to guide my family members upto the banquet as the way to the banquet was a little narrow. As many of my family members were elderly he provided above and beyond wherein they did not even have to get up much as he even provided us with servers. I was very happy with the enitre experience and Thank you to the entire team of 20 Downtown who were extremely cordial.

featured_reviews.review_text: Very well organized event. Special thanks to Om for taking care of all the requirements perfectly. Looking forward to hosting every event here! He is truly a gem to this establishment excellent in every aspect, from finalizing the event to flawless execution and organization.

The new addition 'PD Hall' Located at Garware Club premises at Marine Drive but it belongs to MCA- Mumbai Cricket Club. Small Square hall which can occupy around 30 people at a time. I personally like the party hall or banquet which is square or rectangle in shape without any pillars. This one is just that. As soon as you entre the hall, left hand side is the small bar counter which is very cute and well equipped, in front of the entrance you can have your main backdrop for the event and the right hand side the buffet setting looks appropriate. It has a kitchen connection door from where food/refill of food comes to the buffet. The party which I attended had delicious finger licking food. Mocktails were served  in a short glasses were very cute.. We could accommodate four round tables with six chairs on each table. MCA has a monopoly of a caterer. We have to go through him only. The caterer on the panel is really good. We had team of two live singer who sang for the evening sang non stop for 3 hours...
We sang along and danced along.
You have to climb five steps to entre the hall. So wheel chair accessibility not there.
The valet parking available.
We can book the PD Hall if you are a member of BCA club or MCA club or the member's guest of any of the above clubs. It is very close to Churchgate station makes it a good choice to have any celebration there.

featured_reviews.name: ADITYA SALVI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Just Steps Away from Churchgate Station – Shri Sunderbai Hall

Located barely a **2-minute walk from Churchgate Railway Station**, **Shri Sunderbai Hall** is one of those places you might pass by without noticing, but once you’ve discovered it, you’ll find yourself coming back again and again.

This **spacious and well-maintained hall** has become a go-to venue for a variety of **pop-up exhibitions, sales, and events** that attract crowds from all over Mumbai. Whether it’s a **mega book fair**, a **trendy clothing and handicraft pop-up**, or a **home decor and lifestyle sale**, there’s always something interesting happening here.

One of the standout features of Sunderbai Hall is its **prime location**—literally a stone’s throw away from Churchgate station, making it easily accessible by train, cab, or even on foot if you're already in the Fort/Marine Lines area. The moment you step out of the station, a short walk brings you to this quiet, convenient venue nestled amid the city's hustle.

The hall itself is **quite large and airy**, with enough space to comfortably host multiple stalls without it feeling cramped. Events here are generally **well-organized** with good crowd management, clear signage, and polite staff who ensure everything runs smoothly. There’s always a buzz of activity, but never chaos—an excellent balance!

What’s even better is that most events here are **free to enter** or charge a nominal fee. Perfect for casual browsing or even planned shopping trips, especially if you're into **book bargains, ethnic fashion, artisanal crafts, or curated home goods**.

In a city like Mumbai where space is a premium, **Sunderbai Hall stands out as a reliable and versatile venue** that consistently delivers quality experiences. If you're in the area, keep an eye out—you never know what treasure trove awaits inside.

📍**Location tip:** Exit Churchgate station from the main gate, take a left, and it's right around the corner. Super easy to find!

🗓️**Pro tip:** Check local event listings or posters at the station—there’s always something new happening here!
